description: Remove tags from a Zendesk ticket. This action is irreversible; once tags are removed, they cannot be recovered without re-adding them. Use when you need to clean up ticket tags, remove outdated labels, or clear all tags from a ticket.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for removing tags from a Zendesk ticket.

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tag names to remove from the ticket. If not provided, all tags will be removed from the ticket.
tags.human_parameter_description: A comma-separated list of tag names to remove from the ticket. For example: 'urgent, escalation, vip'. Leave empty to remove all tags.
tags.title: Tags

ticket_id.description: The ID of the ticket to remove tags from
ticket_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the Zendesk ticket from which you want to remove tags. You can find this in the ticket's URL or from a ticket list.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id

inputSchema.title: DeleteTicketsTagsRequest

name: delete_tickets_tags

DeleteTicketsTagsResponse.description: Response containing the remaining tags on the ticket after deletion.

tags.description: An array of tag strings representing all tags currently on the ticket after removal
tags.title: Tags
